The details

Studio standards, made warm.

How do I book, and what is the retainer?

Books release monthly on the 22nd at 3 PM. A $50 reservation retainer secures your seat and goes toward your service; the remaining balance is cash at your appointment.

Is the shampoo really included?

Yes. Every braid appointment begins with the Signature Experience, a clarifying shampoo, ACV prep, and a healthy-hair foundation, always included. Braided styles include the hair; quickweaves ask you to bring 3-4 quality bundles.

What are the Experience tiers?

Every service starts with the Signature Experience. Elevate it with the Elevated (+$55) or Elite (+$95) tiers for a detox cleanse, hydra-steam, deep conditioning, and premium finishes.

How should I arrive and prep?

There is a 10-minute grace period. Come with clean, healthy hair and scalp; if you have any scalp or hair conditions, just note them when you book so your look lasts and stays healthy.

Reschedules and cancellations?

One reschedule is welcome with 48 hours notice using the same retainer. Life happens, just reach out early through your confirmation email and we will keep your spot.

How do I reach you?

SBK runs on written communication so I can stay fully present with every client. Text 470.714.9982 or use your booking, and every question is documented and answered efficiently.

Ready?
